m.aarti.tek: The āratī of the holy Rāmāyaṇa, adorned with the lovely glory of Sītā's beloved.
m.aarti.pad1: Brahmā and the other gods, the sage Nārada, Vālmīki, versed in realised knowledge, Śuka, Sanaka and his brothers, Śeṣa and Sarasvatī sing it; Hanumān, son of the Wind, tells of the fair glory.
m.aarti.pad2: The Vedas and the eighteen Purāṇas sing it; it is the essence of the six śāstras and of all the scriptures, the wealth of sages and the all-in-all of saints, the choice portion, approved by all.
m.aarti.pad3: Śiva and Bhavānī sing it ceaselessly, and Agastya, the pot-born sage of realised knowledge; Vyāsa and the other great poets have praised it; it dwells in the hearts of Kākabhuśuṇḍi and Garuḍa.
m.aarti.pad4: It takes away the filth of the Kali age and makes the taste of sense pleasures insipid; it is the lovely adornment of the maiden Liberation, the herb of nectar that destroys the disease of worldly existence, and in every way father and mother to Tulasīdāsa.
